questionEn: What characteristic refers to the concept of “allotropy”?
choicesEn: the phenomenon of the formation of several simple substances from one chemical element
substances consisting of atoms of the same element
substances consisting of atoms of various elements
changes in the shape of an element that differs from each other in physical and chemical properties
choicesUz: bir kimyoviy elementdan bir nechta oddiy moddalar hosil bo'lish hodisasi
bir xil element atomlaridan tashkil topgan moddalar
turli elementlarning atomlaridan tashkil topgan moddalar
fizik va kimyoviy xossalari bilan bir-biridan farq qiluvchi element shaklining o'zgarishi
explanationEn: Allotropy is the phenomenon of the formation of several simple substances from one chemical element.
explanationUz: Allotropiya - bir kimyoviy elementdan bir nechta oddiy moddalar hosil bo'lish hodisasi.
